name: Sticky Hoisin Beef Bowls

components.name: Sticky Hoisin Beef
steps: Mix sliced beef with small amount of soy, cornstarch, bicarbonate, grated garlic and ginger. Rest for 10–15 minutes.
Sear meat in a very hot wide pan in batches; use a little oil and avoid stirring constantly.
Whisk hoisin, remaining soy, oyster sauce, honey, sesame oil and a splash of stock.
Add sauce to the pan and simmer until just sticky. Toss beef in sauce 2–3 minutes until coated and safely cooked.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Wash jasmine rice until the water is less cloudy. Cover with measured stock, bring to a boil, cook over low heat approximately 12 minutes and rest off heat 5 minutes.
Portion rice and beef across five meals; optionally finish with sesame and sliced spring onion stored separately.
